ns2:section.sectionText: MedPrep is a unique, interactive lecture series that has 4 objectives: (1) To give students accurate, honest, and detailed information on how to become the most competitive and prepared applicant to medical school possible. (2) To clarify the entire educational process required to become a board-certified physician and the lifestyle one can expect in medical school, residency and beyond. (3) To prepare students for the expectations and attitude that will be required of a successful medical student and future physician. (4) To help students decide if medicine is the right career for them. There is no homework and no exams. Attendance is required. Website: https://publish.illinois.edu/mcb199-medprep/
